scope: Provisional Host engineering comparison; not vehicle/ODD safety acceptance
selection: development only; seal one nominee before holdout acquisition; no retuning on holdout
metric: class-aware visible-instance boxes IoU>=0.5; not COCO mAP
runtime_promotion: No automatic replacement of v1. New runtime profile/interface review only after absolute and relative holdout gates pass.
latency: All cold/startup and per-frame measurements retained; experimental accuracy replay is not20Hz qualification

annotation.metric: visible tight boxes IoU>=0.5; no amodal extrapolation
annotation.small_ignore_diagnostic: unmatched same-class IoU>=0.5; one prediction per excluded instance; never changes gates
annotation.covered_miss_diagnostic: same-class prediction covers>=80% of visible target but fails IoU0.5; not a TP

legacy_data: Exclude every consumed V1-V7/domain/training image and all V8 preparation attempts
candidate_version: Official pretrained L full view; no new training or threshold/board optimization
revision_reason: New Town04 map-only sites after 5-model development screen; prior L/L6 failures retained
design_data: Only consumed V4-V7 development324 screen; no old holdout imagery or predictions replayed
preparation_revision: v8b-person-occluder20cm; initial198 raw/FAIL retained before model inference
